name: halve the bracket, keeping the half with the sign change
mechanism: given two points where the function has opposite signs, evaluate at the midpoint and keep whichever half still changes sign; the bracket halves every step, so the error is known exactly in advance

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Bisection method' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Root finding:

requires: a continuous function and an initial sign change
fails_when: one bit per evaluation; cannot find roots without a sign change (even multiplicity)
